command: set -eu; echo '===CHROME==='; pgrep -af '/opt/google/chrome/chrome --app=http://127.0.0.1:8788/' || true; echo '===WINDOWS==='; xdotool search --onlyvisible --name '.*' 2>/dev/null | while read w; do printf '%s ' "$w"; xdotool getwindowname "$w" 2>/dev/null || true; done | sed -n '1,80p'; echo '===PORTS==='; ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E ':(8788|9222|9223|9333)\b' || true; echo '===HTTP==='; curl -fsS -o /dev/null -w 'http=%{http_code} bytes=%{size_download} time=%{time_total}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8788/
